node.statement: Endpoint/positive-parameter case split closing the correction step. The error tolerances delta and epsilon are nonnegative, so e=delta+epsilon is nonnegative. If e=0, then delta=epsilon=0. Substitution in the already established amplified estimates of node 1.3.1 gives, for every n and X,Y, ||T_n(XY)-T_n(X)T_n(Y)||<=0 and ||T_n(I)-I||<=0, while dagger preservation is exact. Hence the linear map T:M_r->B(H_1) is itself an exact unital dagger-homomorphism at level one (and its fixed amplifications have the same exact identities); define mu_11:=T. Then ||mu_11,n-T_n||=0=kappa*e for every n. If e>0, shrink the universal threshold further so that e<a_corr/A_0 and retain the preceding defect bound with correction parameter a=A_0*e. Then 0<a<a_corr, node 1.2 applies, and its single level-one unital dagger-homomorphism mu_11 satisfies ||mu_11,n-T_n||<C_corr*A_0*e=kappa*e for every n, hence also the asserted at-most bound. These two cases exhaust e>=0 and use no level-, rank-, or dimension-dependent choice.
